body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. If you attacked this target with your previous Ballistics Action, ignore 1 point of cover bonus.

surges.html: On a hit, the target has -1 Fortitude against your next Ballistics Action until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Lock - Targeting
rider.html: Establish Lock after resolving. If it was already Locked, preserve that Lock through one loss of sight until the end of your next turn.
